item.title: Graph neural network prediction of temperature-dependent hydrogen diffusion and thermal conductivity tensors of tungsten containing helium bubbles and grain boundaries
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 S. Saito, M. I. Kobayashi, T. Kasahara
arXiv:2608.15609v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Helium bubbles and grain boundaries in tungsten plasma-facing components alter hydrogen-isotope transport and thermal conduction by orders of magnitude, yet evaluating these transport properties for a given microstructure requires hours of molecular dynamics (MD) per configuration. We present a graph neural network surrogate that maps a tungsten atomic configuration containing helium bubbles and grain boundaries directly to the full 3×3 symmetric tensors of the hydrogen diffusion coefficient D_H(T) and the thermal conductivity κ(T) at arbitrary temperature. item.title: 用于带电点缺陷的多保真机器学习原子间势
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xinwei Wang, Irea Mosquera-Lois, Aron Walsh
该工作指出，现有基础机器学习原子间势难以准确描述半导体 Sb₂Se₃ 的缺陷物理，尤其是在配位环境和电子数偏离理想晶体时。作者引入全局缺陷电荷嵌入以区分不同电荷态的成键特征，并采用多保真策略结合低成本半局域数据与高质量杂化泛函能量和力。所得力场能够以远低于直接量子力学计算的成本预测稳定缺陷结构和缺陷热力学，并与量子力学结果定量一致。

item.title: Phonon-Mediated Thermal Transport in Nanocrystalline Silicon Using Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Houssem Rezgui, Catalina Coll Benejam, Clivia M. Sotomayor Torres, Miguel Pruneda
arXiv:2607.06470v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding phonon-mediated heat transport in structurally complex materials remains a central challenge for next-generation electronic and nanomechanical devices, where grain boundaries and interfacial disorder strongly limit thermal dissipation. Although classical interatomic potentials enable large-scale simulations, their limited transferability can lead to inaccuracies in vibrational properties and interfacial phonon scattering. In this work, we develop a machine learning-based framework for modeling thermal transport in bulk and nanocrystalline silicon by combining Gaussian approximation potential and multi-atomic cluster expansion models with lattice-dynamical calculations and molecular dynamics. Harmonic and anharmonic force co…

item.title: 从从头算分子动力学轨迹高数据效率构建材料特异性机器学习原子间势
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jonas Hänseroth, Christian Dreßler
预训练机器学习原子间势为原子模拟提供了有吸引力的起点，但若无额外参考数据，其材料特异性精度常受限制。本文系统比较五种通用 MLIP 框架在七类化学多样体系中的微调与从头训练表现，发现 10 个 AIMD 构型通常不足，200 个在有利情况下可行，而 2000 个构型是更稳健的默认选择。研究还指出，同样数据下从头训练常可与朴素微调竞争，且应在目标可观测量层面验证模型。

arXiv:2605.29683v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a comprehensive benchmarking dataset and empirical scaling law analysis for neural network wavefunctions by matching them to a wide spectrum of famous many body target wavefunctions. We introduce a systematic and reproducible benchmarking protocol for target wavefunction matching, enabling consistent performance evaluation across different neural network wavefunction architectures. item.title: ChemReporter: A Framework for Curating and Exporting Large-Scale Chemical Datasets for MLIP Training
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Marie Bluntzer, Jules Tilly, Christoph Brunken
arXiv:2608.16418v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Training set quality and diversity are key determinants of the reliability of machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs), yet using massive datasets in full is often impractical and redundant, making intelligent data selection essential. A major bottleneck, however, is the lack of infrastructure for uniformly accessing, curating, and subsampling heterogeneous large-scale chemical datasets, which differ widely in structure, metadata, and file format. We address this gap with ChemReporter, a modular, method-agnostic framework that converts arbitrary molecular and materials datasets into a unified, queryable representation and exports the results directly into MLIP-ready training data. item.title: Unlocking Multi-Component Bulk-Materials Molecular Dynamics with a Small-Footprint Machine Learning Interatomic Potential
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yucheng Ouyang, Xin Chen, Ying Liu, Lifang Wang, Xingyu Gao, Xiawei Du, Jianierken Habudelihan, Haifeng Song, Huimin Cui, Xiaobing Feng, Jingling Xue
arXiv:2608.16329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bulk materials, as opposed to nanomaterials, require molecular dynamics (MD) simulations on a large spatial scale (~10⁹ atoms or more) to adequately capture their atomic-scale physical properties. Previously, the introduction of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) has extended MD to this scale, but even single-component bulk systems require tens of thousands of GPUs on high-end supercomputers. However, multi-component bulk MD simulations remain barely achievable, as the HBM footprint of existing MLIPs - already substantial for single-component systems - grows explosively in multi-component scenarios. This paper proposes an MLIP with a small HBM footprint - less than 3% that of existing MLIPs - unlocking multi-component bulk MD us…

item.title: 交替磁 CoF₂ 中的反铁四极有序
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Daniel Halliday, Laura Pöysti, Chung Xu, Daniel A. Mayoh, Didier Wermeille, Dharmalingam Prabhakaran, David R. Bowler, Roger D. Johnson
交替磁体具有非相对论自旋劈裂电子态，其微观起源理论上与隐藏电荷有序相关，但实验研究有限。本文结合共振弹性 X 射线散射、对称性分析和从头算计算，在 d 波交替磁化合物 CoF₂ 中直接观测并识别出反铁四极电荷有序。电子结构计算表明该有序导致典型交替磁自旋劈裂，证明 CoF₂ 中交替磁性的微观起源是反铁四极有序。

arXiv:2608.16247v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The origin of the proposed bond disproportionated insulating state of the non-centrosymmetric (Pnn2) phase of Ag₂BiO₃ is explored using first principles electronic structure calculations. The novel insulating state is elucidated by first considering the initially proposed centosymmetric metallic (Pnna) phase of Ag₂BiO₃. However, phonon calculations indicate that the metallic (Pnna) state is dynamically unstable. item.title: 面向二维枝晶全链条高实验效率合成的数据-知识双驱动智能框架
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Wenqiang Huang, Xuhang Gu, Susu Fang, Shen'ao Xue, Huanhuan Xing, Junjie Jiang, Junying Zhang, Shen Zhou, Zheng Luo, Jin Zhang, Fangping Ouyang, Shanshan Wang
该研究以二维枝晶的化学气相沉积生长为例，提出一个机器智能赋能的材料合成全链条框架，覆盖工艺快速优化、定制合成和机制解析。作者将主动学习嵌入实验流程，用少量实验找到高分枝、电催化活性 ReSe₂ 枝晶的优化配方，并通过数据增强和树模型揭示工艺变量与分形维数之间的非线性关系。进一步结合跨尺度表征、可解释机器学习和热力学/动力学知识，构建了数据-知识双驱动机制模型，用于解析多参数对形貌的协同作用。

arXiv:2603.07977v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials (MLIPs) enable accurate large-scale atomistic simulations, yet improving their expressive capacity efficiently remains challenging. item.title: Bound states in doped charge transfer insulators
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Pengfei Li, Yang Shen, Mingpu Qin, Kun Jiang, Jiangping Hu, Tao Xiang
arXiv:2408.00576v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding the physics of doped charge transfer insulators is the most important problem in high-temperature superconductivity. In this work, we show that an in-gap bound state emerges from the localized hole of the doped charge transfer insulator. We propose an approximate ground state wavefunction based on one localized Zhang-Rice singlet and the Neel state. By calculating the excitation states with one hole added and removed from this ground state, we successfully identify the existence of bound states inside the charge transfer gap. This feature is further confirmed by a Lanczos calculation based on matrix product states (MPS) for a system of 4×4 CuO₂ unit cells. item.title: 外延应变双层镍酸盐 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中的电子结构与磁关联
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 I. V. Leonov
本文采用 DFT 与动力学平均场理论研究电子关联和外延应变对双层 Ruddlesden-Popper 镍酸盐 La₃Ni₂O₇ 正常态性质的影响。结果显示 Ni 3d 能带具有显著轨道选择性重整化和强非相干性，且电子性质对应变高度敏感。拉伸和适度压缩应变增强磁关联，而约 -4% 的大压缩应变引发 Lifshitz 转变并削弱磁关联，暗示超导受抑制。

arXiv:2608.16232v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Low-dimensional materials exhibit extraordinary properties that make them promising candidates for advanced technologies. Although they have been investigated extensively, most of the research has focused on layered two-dimensional (2D) materials. We find that nearly all chains have a buckled ground state, nine chains are distorted, and three chains---Cd, Hg, and Sr---are semiconducting with an electronic gap. item.title: 用于哈密顿量降维的内禀 Wannier 函数
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Shuoxue Li, Garnet Kin-Lic Chan
本文提出内禀 Wannier 函数方法，用于将从头算材料能带结构降维到具有指定原子特征的低能轨道子空间。该方法非迭代，并且只需一个无量纲参数来解缠能带。硅、石墨烯和汞基铜氧化物三带模型的基准测试表明，该方法可获得与标准方法相比质量较高的降维能带结构，并适合高通量应用。

该工作研究有限程相互作用如何改变弱相互作用超冷玻色混合气中的量子液滴性质。作者建立自洽有效理论，推导零温三维玻色混合物的解析状态方程，并指出种间吸引会引入由短程相互作用细节决定的非普适 LHY 项。研究还预测这些非普适项会导致呼吸模频率的分数偏移，可作为实验探测量子液滴动力学和原子间势特征的信号。

item.title: Exact Bounds on Exponential Concentration for Block-Product Quantum Fidelity Kernels
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Mezbah Uddin Rafi
We characterize the achievable second-moment concentration exponent for block-product fidelity quantum kernels whose per-block ensembles have a maximally mixed first moment. For n = mb qubits partitioned into m independent b-qubit blocks, with no entangling gate crossing a block boundary, the exponent c, defined by E[κ²] = 2⁻ᶜⁿ, satisfies c ∈ [1, c(b)] for every finite b, where c(b) = [(b−1) + log₂(2ᵇ+1)]/b increases monotonically from log₂ 3 ≈ 1.585 at b=1 to 2 as b→∞. arXiv:2511.07249v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electrostatics govern charge transfer and reactivity in materials. However, most foundation potentials (FPs) either neglect explicit electrostatic interactions or come at prohibitive computational cost. Here, we introduce charge-equilibrated TensorNet (QET), an equivariant, charge-aware architecture that achieves linear scaling with system size via an analytically solvable charge-equilibration scheme. 该研究结合密度泛函理论和高角环形暗场扫描透射电子显微术，考察扭转双层 1T'-WTe₂ 中一维莫尔超晶格的结构弛豫和电子性质。结果表明晶格弛豫会强烈重构莫尔条纹，并在费米能级附近产生准一维电子能带。作者进一步证明这些一维电子态主要来自面内晶格弛豫诱导的层内莫尔势，而非层间杂化，并构建了能再现实空间局域和能带色散的有效紧束缚模型。

item.description:

👤 Ye Ma
该论文研究动量依赖相似变换在开放边界条件下何时能保持晶格哈密顿量的谱性质。作者指出，这类变换在无限系统中可精确保持谱，但在有限系统中会因实空间逆变换的长程性质而产生细微问题。论文还针对一般无迹 2×2 哈密顿量推导了通过常数相似变换化为反对角形式的充要条件，并给出体谱保持的严格条件；输入摘要在最后一句处截断，完整条件需查阅原文。
